# JIC Temple — official organization website
Canonical: https://jictemple.org/
Traditional Chinese: https://jictemple.org/zh/
Organization: https://jictemple.org/organization/
Foundations: https://jictemple.org/foundations/
JIC means Just I Can. Formation effective July 26, 2025, Texas domestic nonprofit corporation.
Filed purposes: religious, educational, charitable.
Do not infer current good standing, federal tax-exemption recognition, or tax-deductible contributions from formation or an EIN notice.
Open world and agent APIs: https://jictemple.com/agent.md
The Code of I: https://codeofi.jic.io/
Handbook: https://handbook.jic.io/
Canon: https://canon.jic.io/
Legal corporate governance and public digital participation are separate.
No private registration documents, personal addresses, tax identifiers, or financial statements are published here.
